Home.aboutTitle: LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS — a trusted passenger transport operator in London
Home.aboutSubtitle: Transfers, corporate transport and group travel
Home.aboutText: LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS is a transport company that organises passenger transport in London and beyond. We work with private clients, companies and groups. We structure every trip as a managed process — from receiving the request to completing the route. This approach ensures a consistent level of service, regardless of the transport format and number of passengers.
Home.servicesTitle: Transfers and transport for every need
Home.servicesSubtitle: We organise trips across London and beyond — from individual transfers to group and corporate transport.
Home.serviceAirportDesc: Transfers to Heathrow, Gatwick, Stansted, Luton and London City. Meet and greet, baggage assistance, flight monitoring.
Home.serviceCorporateDesc: Transport for employees and clients. Vehicles for business events and regular routes.
Home.serviceGroupDesc: Minibuses and coaches for groups. Schools, tourists, corporate trips.
Home.servicePrivateDesc: Weddings, events, city trips and beyond. Adapting vehicles to client requirements.
advantagesItems: Single operator for different transport formats
Home.benefitsTitle: Why clients choose LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS for private and corporate transport
Home.benefitsSubtitle: We work with private and corporate clients, providing managed and predictable transport solutions
Home.benefitsText: LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS is focused on working with various client categories — from private customers to companies and organised groups. Our operating model allows us to adapt the transport format to each client's needs while maintaining a consistent service level and control regardless of order scale.
Home.benefitsNoUniversal: We don't offer one-size-fits-all solutions — every trip is built around the client's requirements, trip format and organisational conditions.
benefitsClientsItems: Private clients: individual trips, airport transfers, family routes and private events

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.description: How LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS uses cookies and similar technologies on its website.

sections.p: This Cookie Policy explains how LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS uses cookies and similar technologies on its website.
items: The use of cookies is governed by:
UK GDPR
Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations (PECR)

sections.p: Cookies are small text files that are stored on a user's device when visiting a website. They enable the website to recognise the user's device and remember certain information.
items: Session cookies — deleted after the browser is closed
Persistent cookies — remain on the device for a specified period

sections.p: Strictly necessary cookies are required for the proper functioning of the website and do not require user consent. They are used to ensure basic website functionality, preserve user preferences and maintain security.
items: Analytics cookies are used to analyse user behaviour and improve website performance. These cookies are only used with the user's consent.
Functional cookies allow the website to remember user preferences such as language or interface settings. They are only used with consent unless they are strictly necessary.

sections.p: Strictly necessary cookies are used on the basis of legitimate interest. All other cookies are used solely on the basis of user consent.
Upon first visiting the website, a cookie banner is displayed enabling the user to:
items: Accept all cookies
Reject all non-essential cookies
Customise cookie categories
sections.p: Cookies other than strictly necessary ones are not set until consent is obtained.
The user may at any time:
items: Change cookie settings through the website interface
Delete cookies through browser settings
Block cookies at the browser level
sections.p: Disabling cookies may affect website functionality.
We may use third-party services, such as analytics tools, that set cookies on their own behalf. Such third parties process data in accordance with their own privacy policies.
The retention period of cookies depends on their type:
items: Session cookies are deleted after the browser is closed
Persistent cookies are stored for a limited period or until deleted by the user

sections.p: LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS reserves the right to update this Policy at any time. The current version is always available on the website.
For enquiries relating to the use of cookies, you may contact LONDON ROUTE TRANSFERS using the contact details provided on the website.
